lines.text: God tells Aaron to bring the Levites to assist him, but they must not come near the furnishings or the altar.
God gives the Levites as a gift to Aaron, and only Aaron and his sons serve inside the veil.
God gives Aaron's family the offerings, and a month-old firstborn son is redeemed for ten shekels of silver.
God tells Aaron that the LORD is his inheritance, and the Levites receive all the firstfruits in Israel as theirs.
God tells Moses that the Levites must give a tithe of the tithe, and Aaron the priest receives it.
